chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
The shroud is to be provided from the entirety of the wealth.

key_terms.الْكَفَنُ: the burial shroud used for the deceased
key_terms.جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ: the entirety of the deceased's wealth or estate

ai.seo_question: Is the burial shroud paid for from the deceased’s estate?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the estate of the deceased. It states that the burial shroud is to be taken from the deceased’s total wealth, indicating that this funeral expense is charged to the estate.
